video_title: My First Day With The Miami HEAT

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo on his goal to win another championship
quotes.excerpt: I've accomplished a lot of things in my career but, one of my goals is to win another championship.
quotes.quote: I've accomplished a lot of things in my career but, one of my goals is to win another championship. I feel like this is the best route for me to do that. I enjoy the challenge. I enjoy getting better.

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo on his gratitude for his time with the Milwaukee Bucks
quotes.excerpt: I'm so grateful and happy the 13 years I was with the Milwaukee Bucks because I had incredible memories.
quotes.quote: I'm so grateful and happy the 13 years I was with the Milwaukee Bucks because I had incredible memories. They made me, they allowed me to be me. They allowed me to walk in the streets with my flip flops, my sweats. I feel like they were my family. You never know in life, maybe our roads meet again. But for now, let's go win a championship.

quotes.speaker: Erik Spoelstra
quotes.summary_phrase: Erik Spoelstra and Giannis Antetokounmpo on the pressure of winning
quotes.excerpt: You have to feel like your life is dependent on this because you are going to do everything possible to win.

text_blocks.speaker: Erik Spoelstra
text_blocks.text: We've been under the radar for four years. We've had huge expectations, but it's all been internal. There's been no pressure. If we lose, it's okay. Now there's going to be pressure. We need that too. That's what you're bringing.

text_blocks.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
text_blocks.text: I need it too. You have to feel like your life is dependent on this because you are going to do everything possible to win. I haven't had that feeling for a long time, and I feel like now I have it.

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo on the importance of learning the team's system
quotes.excerpt: If I don't know the offense, how can I talk to my teammates?
quotes.quote: I want to know everything, offense, defense, so when training camp comes, I'm almost ahead of them. I can talk to them. If I don't know the offense, how can I talk to my teammates?

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo explains the significance of his jersey number
quotes.excerpt: My mom was born in 1963, so I took the three. My dad was born in 1964, so I took the 3 and the 4 and I made 34.
quotes.quote: I always wore 34. My mom was born in 1963, so I took the three. My dad was born in 1964, so I took the 3 and the 4 and I made 34. And now I just want to honor them in a different way. Adding 3 + 4, what does that equal? 7. And my mom was born April 7th, so I took the 7.

quotes.speaker: Pat Riley
quotes.summary_phrase: Pat Riley on the impact of Earvin Johnson's arrival
quotes.excerpt: When we drafted Earvin Johnson, and he walked in for a Summer League game unannounced. Every kid in the arena got up behind him and followed like a pied piper.

text_blocks.speaker: Pat Riley
text_blocks.text: I remember when we drafted Earvin Johnson, and he walked in for a Summer League game unannounced. He came in, walked through up the stairs, every kid in the arena got up behind him and followed like a pied piper all the way around. He had that kind of aura. I just got goosebumps thinking about it.

text_blocks.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
text_blocks.text: Anytime you want. Because I'm only 25 feet from the court, they think I'm the principal, I'm not. Anytime you wanna come in, it's open for you too.

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo on the Miami Heat culture
quotes.excerpt: You always hear about the Miami Heat culture and that guys work hard, guys are very disciplined, guys are very driven, and guys are very selfless.
quotes.quote: You always hear about the Miami Heat culture and that guys work hard, guys are very disciplined, guys are very driven, and guys are very selfless. They give everything that they can to win. All that matters is winning. In order for me to go to the next level, I got to get out of my comfort zone, and I felt like Miami was a place for me to be.
